database_provenance.difference_justification: Legitimate v2.3.1 schema migrations (sync_runs table, job_sources columns) and legitimate background discovery worker health records. Candidate and user rows are 100% identical.
database_provenance.hard_guard_verified: Pytest hard guard in get_db_connection prevents tests from reading/writing live production database.

lease_concurrency.mechanism: SQLite atomic BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction leasing
lease_concurrency.fencing_protection: StaleWorkerLeaseError raised if lease lost before mutation commit
lease_concurrency.generational_safety: Verified across multiple worker generations (Gen 1 & Gen 2 locked out by Gen 3)
lease_concurrency.supported_topology: Single-node multi-process (local NVMe/SSD with WAL mode)
lease_concurrency.unsupported_topology: Network filesystems (NFS/EFS/CIFS) - Requires PostgreSQL advisory locks
